title: Elite: The Envoy Refuses Defeat
description: Marble Law, Iron Oath: The Envoy Refuses Defeat unfolds across floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian squad to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: The Envoy Refuses Defeat advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails

objectives.primary: Win the trial objective without abandoning Asgardian formation law. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.
optional: Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

boss.notes: Boss pressure tied to banner command and broken-oath memory.

specialRules: Trial Terms: optional objectives change rewards but never overwrite faction identity.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Elite Storm: lightning collapse advances one turn earlier.
Elite Banner Law: enemy buffs persist until objective action breaks the source.
victoryConditions: Win the trial objective without abandoning Asgardian formation law. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure
